assembly_enter: left-click the whole microscope to enter the preassembly view.
point the right-hand ray at the whole microscope and press the trigger to enter the preassembly view.
The overall model and viewing angle.
assembly_expand: click the whole model again and wait for the expansion animation.
point the right-hand ray at the whole model and press the trigger again. Wait for expansion to finish.
The structure of the separated components.
assembly_exit: click outside the model to return one assembly level. Free exploration resumes in Normal mode.
point the right-hand ray outside the model and press the trigger to return one assembly level.
Exiting returns one level at a time.
parts_select: click a component and read its description on the right. Upper Optical Assembly links to NA; Objective Lens links to spatial frequency.
point the right-hand ray at a component and press the trigger. Read the panel: Upper Optical Assembly links to NA; Objective Lens links to spatial frequency.
Compare the component name, function, and experiment entry.
parts_exit: click a blank area outside both the description panel and selected component to finish viewing it.
point the right-hand ray outside the selection UI and component, then press the trigger to leave the selection.
Return to the view where other components can be selected.
na_start: click Start Numerical Aperture Experiment and wait for the transition.
use the right-hand UI ray to select Start Numerical Aperture Experiment, then wait for the transition.
The NA panel appears before you adjust the slider.
na_adjust: drag the NA slider, changing only NA at a time.
use the right-hand UI ray to drag the NA slider, changing only NA at a time.
Compare the half-angle, collection cone, and display changes. Approximate magnification and image changes are teaching mappings; NA is not magnification.
na_exit: click Exit and wait to return to the component view.
use the right-hand UI ray to select Exit and wait to return to the component view.
The Upper Optical Assembly description returns.
sf_start: click Start Spatial Frequency Experiment and wait for the transition.
use the right-hand UI ray to select Start Spatial Frequency Experiment and wait for the transition.
sf_high: use the right-hand UI ray to select High.
This setting is 250 lines/mm. Keep the specimen and illumination fixed; compare the grating, spectrum, and sidebands.
sf_middle: use the right-hand UI ray to select Middle.
This setting is 125 lines/mm. Keep the specimen and illumination fixed; compare the grating, spectrum, and sidebands.
sf_low: use the right-hand UI ray to select Low.
This setting is 62.5 lines/mm. Keep the specimen and illumination fixed; compare the grating, spectrum, and sidebands.
sf_white: use the right-hand UI ray to select White Light.
Keep frequency and specimen fixed and compare the illustrative illumination feedback.
sf_laser: use the right-hand UI ray to select Laser Excitation.
Keep frequency and specimen fixed and compare the illustrative illumination feedback.
sf_exit: click Exit and wait to return to the objective component view.
use the right-hand UI ray to select Exit and wait to return to the objective component view.
snom_begin: use the right-hand UI ray to select Begin Operation.
snom_probe_0: use the right-hand UI ray to select the Fine probe option.
The probe description and preview change. The 3x label indicates illustrative relative detail, not objective magnification.
snom_probe_1: use the right-hand UI ray to select the Standard probe option.
The probe description and preview change. The 2x label indicates illustrative relative detail, not objective magnification.
snom_probe_2: use the right-hand UI ray to select the Robust probe option.
The probe description and preview change. The 1x label indicates illustrative relative detail, not objective magnification.
snom_install: click Install Selected Probe and wait for installation to finish.
use the right-hand UI ray to select Install Selected Probe, then wait for installation to finish.
The probe moves to its mount. Start System becomes available after installation.
snom_start: use the right-hand UI ray to select Start System.
The automatic principle tour begins after probe installation.
snom_change: use the right-hand UI ray to select Change Probe.
snom_next: use the right-hand UI ray to select Next.
The next tour stage appears, or the next component in Components mode.
snom_previous: use the right-hand UI ray to select Previous.
The previous tour stage appears, or the previous component in Components mode.
snom_replay: use the right-hand UI ray to select Replay.
The current stage replays, or the current component is shown again in Components mode.
snom_play: use the right-hand UI ray to select the play/pause button.
Pause to inspect details or resume the demonstration.
snom_components: click Components / Back to Tour to switch between component descriptions and the principle tour.
use the right-hand UI ray to select Components / Back to Tour.
In Components mode, select a highlighted component to read its name and function.
snom_exit: use the right-hand UI ray to select Exit.
The current SNOM session ends and the laboratory view returns.
sample_pick: left-click to pick up the specimen currently in interaction range.
press the right-hand trigger to pick up the specimen currently in interaction range.
The specimen preview changes. Picking up is distinct from placing it.
sample_place: press Z to place the held specimen.
press the left-hand trigger to place the held specimen.
Confirm that the specimen appears on the stage.
sample_observe: press Z to advance the current observation viewpoint.
press the left-hand trigger to advance the current observation viewpoint.
Wait for the viewpoint change. Another input may be needed to enter observation.
sample_remove: left-click to remove the specimen from the stage, avoiding SNOM and exploded-model targets.
press the right-hand trigger to remove the stage specimen, keeping the ray away from SNOM and exploded-model targets.
light: press B to toggle the light source.
press the right-hand secondaryButton to toggle the light source.
The illumination switches on or off.
objective: press the right-hand primaryButton to switch objectives.
The objective position and magnification display change.
focus: press Tab to switch coarse/fine adjustment. Hold X and use the left/right arrow keys to focus.
press the right thumbstick to switch coarse/fine adjustment. Hold the left-hand primaryButton and move the right thumbstick left/right to focus.
Compare clarity changes. Focusing does not change the objective intrinsic focal length.
brightness: hold X and use the up/down arrow keys to adjust illumination.
hold the left-hand primaryButton and move the right thumbstick up/down to adjust illumination.
Compare brightness changes; they do not establish a change in specimen structure.
observe_exit: press the left-hand trigger to leave observation.
snom_open: left-click the SNOM interaction target to show its entry panel.
point the right-hand ray at the SNOM entry target and press the trigger to show its entry panel.
